manifest.method: Fresh complete-input replication of the original two-form clock notation cost; four pairs meet the canonical runner minimum. No added date conversion, English expansions, changed tokenizer roster or semantic claim.
manifest.scope: Narrow literal token comparison only. London in the source denotes Europe/London; this cost test does not establish the safety or adequacy of that unqualified wording.

comparison_identity.comparator: HH:MMZ versus HH:MM UTC and HH:MM@Europe/London versus HH:MM London; identical clock digits in each pair
comparison_identity.population: Equal mixture of UTC and London clock-expression pairs; four fresh complete pairs replace the original two, preserving its two-form mixture. No date conversion or timezone-understanding inference.
comparison_identity.aggregation: Equal pair means per tokenizer; maximum tokenizer mean (least-favourable) over the same cl100k_base, o200k_base and p50k_base roster.
comparison_identity.unit_span: one bare clock-time expression with its time-zone notation
